copy.home.h1: Fractional Business Development leadership for construction and AEC
copy.home.subhead: A senior commercial operator inside the firm — pipeline, qualification, and weekly cadence — without a full-time executive hire. Other workstreams open only after this seat is real.
copy.home.why.h2: An operator in the commercial seat
copy.home.why.lead: Daniel Reid, MBA, PMP, LEED AP, founded ISI to put a commercial operator in the seat — the same work run as National Sales Manager, VP of Business Development, and Director of Sales across construction, architecture, manufacturing, and automation.
copy.home.why.punch: Fractional Business Development is the tollgate. Everything else follows the constraint.
copy.home.why.body: If the gap is a missing commercial leader, we install one. If the gap is margin, cash, throughput, or a broken project system, the diagnostic opens — after the Business Development seat is honest about what it can and cannot close.
copy.home.solutions.h2: The Business Development seat first. The rest only if proven.
copy.home.solutions.lead: Fractional Business Development leadership is the engagement the site is built on. Strategy, financial solutions, startup plans, project management, coaching, and manufacturing practice sit behind that gate — construction and AEC.
copy.home.cta.body: Most construction and AEC firms feel the pressure in the pipeline first. A short consultation names whether fractional Business Development is the engagement — or whether finance, operations, or a diagnostic should open instead.
